notes: Update over OTA as usual — nothing needs to be flashed over USB.

This is the version that can actually read the current hub manifest. On 1.7.2 "Перевірити оновлення" answers malformed manifest, so this one still has to be installed by hand; from here on the hub button works.

[Hub] "Перевірити оновлення" failed with malformed manifest (web_server.c) The manifest is fetched into a fixed buffer that was 1024 bytes, but with the per-board section added in 1.7.2 the real file is ~1.3 KB. The body was cut at 1023…

[Hub] Release notes were cut off mid-sentence (.github/scripts/sync-hub.js) Only the first line of each CHANGELOG bullet was taken, but bullets wrap over several lines, so the published notes ended like "…the build target as".…
[CI] sync-hub.yml now fails clearly when no tag is supplied, instead of running gh release download "".
